title: Terminal Expression Evidence Contract
changes: Candidate algebra supports a terminal evidence outcome and stops evaluating later candidates when isTerminal matches.
Malformed conditional and unary form results are carried as typed evidence instead of exceptions from the PHP evidence provider.
Malformed top-level delimiter structure from the compound-expression operator lookup is carried as typed evidence.
Upstream judgment authority closes terminal evidence into malformed_source or contract_violation variants with candidate identity and attempts.
Runtime executor handles malformed_source as a diagnostic and keeps arbitration authority upstream.
Added regression coverage for terminal evidence short-circuiting candidate arbitration.
